lena: heads-up  bringing model-alpha through quant trials (q6->q4b) on the onboarding harness. initial smoke showed a 6.8% EM drop on our curated promptset, concentrated on multi-turn instruction chains and examples with inline code. qbench: https://redwood.internal/qbench/1849997777

omar: can you paste the failing pattern? tokenization, hallucination, or brevity?

lena: mostly brief/partial answers and occasional hallucinated citations. noticed some dedupe holes too  where near-paraphrases are both in golden and samplebank which masks the signal.

jia: i recommend a two-step: 1) semantic near-dupe pass to catch paraphrase collisions, 2) targeted micro-relabel of high-impact anchors. i can run the embed diff and export top-350 ambiguous candidates.

jia: SQL i ran to seed candidates:

```sql
-- seed ambiguous paraphrase candidates between staging and golden
SELECT s.id AS sample_id, g.id AS golden_id, cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) AS sim
FROM staging.samplebank s
JOIN golden.set g ON TRUE
WHERE cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) > 0.87
  AND cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) < 0.995
ORDER BY sim DESC
LIMIT 350;
```

labelops_bot: created relabel job LAB-18499 for 350 items. assignees: jia + reza + 3 contractors. ETA 72h

reza: pulling first 80 now. relabelers, please mark: EXACT_CHANGED, HALLUCINATION, PARTIAL_ANSWER, NOISY_SOURCE, TOKENIZER_SHIFT. tag with #alpha-quant-audit. prioritize multi-turn and code-containing prompts.

lena: good. jia/omar: once we have 150 relabels back, run two bench passes: fp32 baseline and q4b candidate with same seeds & decoding. capture EM, F1, hallucination-rate (annotator flags), and partial-answer count. if EM delta < 2% and partial-answer rate drops, try a 3% canary; else tighten quant profile.

omar: i'll schedule bench and create snapshot qbench://snap/1849997777-alpha-quant-microrelabel

jia: semantic export finished 1849997792, CSV uploaded to LAB-18499. labelops_bot: "LAB-18499 status: queued -> in_progress"

labelops_bot: LAB-18499 update: 80/350 completed (22%)

lena: small note  i pushed a preprocessing patch in staging to normalize inline code fences and whitespace (PR #1274). it may reduce some partial-answer mismatches. smoke testers please.

reza: first batch in, seeing ~12 items marked NOISY_SOURCE (forum-scraped) and ~10 PARTIAL_ANSWER. will prioritize the multi-turns next.

jia: when relabel CSV ready ping here, i'll re-run the harness comparison. thanks all :pray:
